items.text: Before a single mock test, the bigger question is whether a multi-year UPSC attempt is actually the right route for your strengths, interests, and financial runway, or whether a different high-value path would serve you better. That decision deserves the same rigour as any other high-stakes bet, not just momentum from what everyone around you is attempting.
